_comment: The release build matrix. One GUI binary per OS x CPU architecture: GPU support (CUDA, Metal, Vulkan, ROCm) is not a build dimension, because the bundled CLI downloads the matching llama.cpp asset on the user's machine at setup time. A target belongs here only if the bundled Python (runtime/python_version.json) and upstream's newt pin both have an asset for it -- tests/test_build_targets.py enforces that. 'enabled' decides whether CI builds it on PRs, pushes to main (nightly) and tags; a disabled target is still buildable on demand (workflow_dispatch with `only`) and locally (tools/build.sh --release-target). 'runner' is a GitHub-hosted label, or a list of self-hosted labels. 'bundles' is passed to `tauri build --bundles`.
